name: get_open_closed_orders
description: Get both open (pending) and recently closed orders. Essential for monitoring order status and trading activity. Use this to check if orders are filled, cancelled, or still pending.

category.description: Product category to query orders for

symbol.description: Specific trading pair to get orders for. Leave empty to get all orders in category

baseCoin.description: Base coin filter for derivatives and options

orderLinkId.description: Specific custom order ID to query

openOnly.description: Filter by open orders only: 0 = all orders, 1 = open orders only, 2 = closed orders only

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-50)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

name: get_order_history
description: Get comprehensive order history with detailed information about past orders including execution details, timestamps, and status changes. Useful for trade analysis and record keeping.

category.description: Product category to query order history for

symbol.description: Specific trading pair to get order history for. Leave empty to get all orders in category

baseCoin.description: Base coin filter for derivatives and options

orderLinkId.description: Specific custom order ID to query

startTime.description: Start timestamp in milliseconds for history query

endTime.description: End timestamp in milliseconds for history query

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-50)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

name: get_trade_history
description: Get detailed execution history showing actual trades (fills) with execution prices, quantities, fees, and timestamps. Essential for performance analysis and tax reporting.

category.description: Product category to query trade executions for

symbol.description: Specific trading pair to get trade history for. Leave empty to get all trades in category

baseCoin.description: Base coin filter for derivatives and options

orderId.description: Get trades for specific order ID

orderLinkId.description: Get trades for specific custom order ID

startTime.description: Start timestamp in milliseconds for trade history query

endTime.description: End timestamp in milliseconds for trade history query

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-100)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

name: get_wallet_balance
description: Get detailed wallet balance information including available balance, locked balance, and total equity across different account types. Essential for portfolio monitoring and risk management.

accountType.description: Account type to query balance for. UNIFIED is most common for modern trading

coin.description: Specific coin to get balance for. Leave empty to get all coin balances

name: get_single_coin_balance
description: Get balance information for a specific coin with additional details like transferable amounts and account relationships. More detailed than wallet balance for single coin queries.

accountType.description: Account type to query coin balance for

coin.description: Specific coin to get detailed balance for

toAccountType.description: Target account type for transfer queries (optional)

toMemberId.description: Target member ID for institutional transfers (optional)

withBonus.description: Include bonus balance in results: 0 = exclude bonus, 1 = include bonus

name: get_account_info
description: Get comprehensive account information including margin ratios, account status, upgrade status, and overall account health metrics. Essential for risk monitoring.

name: get_spot_borrow_quota
description: Get the max borrow/trade quota for spot margin trading on a symbol (read-only).

category.description: Product category. Must be 'spot' for borrow quota queries

side.description: Order side to check quota for: 'Buy' or 'Sell'

name: get_position_info
description: Get detailed position information including size, value, PnL, and margin for your trading positions. Essential for portfolio monitoring and risk management.

category.description: Product category to query positions for

symbol.description: Specific trading pair to get position for. Leave empty to get all positions in category

baseCoin.description: Base coin filter for derivatives and options

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-200)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results

name: get_closed_pnl
description: Get historical profit and loss data for closed positions. Useful for performance analysis and tax reporting.

category.description: Product category to query closed PnL for

symbol.description: Specific trading pair to get PnL for. Leave empty to get all closed PnL in category

startTime.description: Start timestamp in milliseconds for PnL query

endTime.description: End timestamp in milliseconds for PnL query

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (1-100)

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for next page of results
